items.source: On the server side the map can be populated initially through a HandshakeInterceptor. On the client side the map can be populated via WebSocketClient handshake methods.
items.translation: 在服务器端，映射可以通过 HandshakeInterceptor 进行初始填充。在客户端，映射可以通过 WebSocketClient 的握手方法进行填充。

items.source: Note: The localAddress is not always possible to access, which is the case with the Standard WebSocket client API, and accordingly StandardWebSocketClient returns null.
items.translation: 注意： 由于 Standard WebSocket 客户端 API 的情况，localAddress 并不总是可以访问，因此StandardWebSocketClient返回null。

items.source: Note: The underlying standard WebSocket session (JSR-356) does not allow concurrent sending. Therefore, sending must be synchronized. To ensure that, one option is to wrap the WebSocketSession with the ConcurrentWebSocketSessionDecorator.
items.translation: 注意： 底层的标准 WebSocket 会话（JSR-356）不允许并发发送。因此，必须对发送操作进行同步。为确保这一点，一种选择是将 WebSocketSession 包装在ConcurrentWebSocketSessionDecorator中。
